title: List the corridors from the command line
prompt: Add a command `python -m remit corridors` that lists the supported corridors, one line each, sorted by code. Each line is the corridor code, two spaces, the minimum and the maximum send amount with two decimals joined by ' to ', then ' QAR', for example `QAR-EGP  100.00 to 15000.00 QAR`. Print nothing else, exit with status 0, and do not create or touch a database file. Add a test.

title: A quote accepted at exactly 60 seconds
prompt: A support agent reports that a customer completed a transfer with a quote that was exactly 60 seconds old. The rule is that a quote is valid for 60 seconds and is expired from the moment it is 60 seconds old. Find the cause and fix it with the smallest change you can. Do not edit existing tests.

title: Make the customer name search safe
prompt: Store.search_by_name builds its SQL with string formatting. A fragment that contains a single quote raises an error, and a crafted fragment changes the query. Make the search safe without changing what it returns for ordinary fragments: a substring match on the name, case-insensitive for ASCII, ordered by id. Do not edit existing tests.

title: What happens to the ledger when saving fails
prompt: Read RemitService.send. If store.save_transfer raises, what happens to the ledger postings that were already made, and what does the customer hear? Answer in ANSWER.md in the repository root, in at most six sentences, and name the functions involved. Change no other file.

title: Pin down how the ledger rounds the partner share
prompt: The ledger rounds the partner's 30% share of the fee half-even, unlike the rest of Remit, which rounds half-up. Write characterization tests for this in tests/test_ledger_partner_share.py: they must pass on today's code and fail if the share were rounded half-up. Do not change any source file.

title: Shorten RemitService.send
prompt: RemitService.send is 89 lines long. Refactor service.py so that no function in it is longer than 70 lines, without changing behaviour: the same errors, the same order of steps, the same messages. Do not edit any test.

title: Bring the architecture page up to date
prompt: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describes a module that no longer exists and an old limits rule. Compare it with the code in src/remit/ and correct the document. Change documentation only, keep every statement you leave in place true, and do not touch the code or the tests.

title: Second review of pull request 482
prompt: review/PR-482.diff is a pull request from a colleague, constructed for this exercise. You are the second reviewer. Write your findings to REVIEW.md in the repository root, one finding per bullet, most serious first, and say for each why it matters. Do not edit the diff or any other file.

title: Invoice rounding in my team's service
prompt: In our invoicing service, an invoice for 3 items at 0.335 each totals 1.02 instead of 1.01, because each line is rounded before the lines are added. Compute the total once from the exact line amounts, using Decimal and rounding half up at the end only. Add a regression test and change nothing else.
